about_the_game:
Acoustic VIBE features Acoustic-Flavored Musical Soundtracks for game developers who want ambient, energetic, light inspirational tunes that feature Acoustic Musical Inspiration!

It's a BGM Collection with an aesthetic medley of acoustic musical expressions!

■ A "Multi-Flavored" Acoustic Musical Experience

Acoustic VIBE is an acoustic musical treat that presents elements of other music genres such as rock, synth and electronic "musical flavors" for an "enhanced musical experience".

■ Ambient, Energetic and Light Inspirational Music

Acoustic VIBE can be used to create a laid-back atmosphere or energetic inspired scenes.

It can be an ideal musical choice for positively-toned games, scenes or moments!

■ A Fresh Break From Usual Game Music

This BGM Collection can be used to vary the musical flavor of game scenes!

Now, game developers can add an "acoustic vibe" to RPGs and Visual Novels and MORE!

■ Multi-Faceted Application For Games

This Acoustic BGM Collection can be applied to: Special and Emotional Game Scenes, "Feel Good Moments", Travel and Exploration Moments and Interface Screens.

■ Exclusive Extras

Acoustic VIBE includes an Exclusive Extra BGM Soundtrack entitled "Hush In A Rush"

If you prefer an acoustic musical pack that's not purely acoustic…

If you want to "take a break from the usual game music" - with a fresh lighter choice…

You can try the ambient, energetic and light inspirational touch of an ACOUSTIC VIBE !

------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

【Musical Content Outline / ESSENTIAL SPECS】

● 10 Main Acoustic-Themed BGM Soundtracks

● Exclusive "Maker Extra" : 1 BGM Soundtrack

● Total Number of BGM Tracks: 11

【Musical Track List / DETAILED SPECS】

1. Acoustic Episodes – 3:00

2. Acoustic Duck Quacks – 2:01

3. Acoustic Beat Zone – 3:00

4. Acoustic Forward Pulse – 2:56

5. Acoustic Wave Ride – 4:19

6. Haze Maze – 2:02

7. RACOUSTIC – 2:48

8. Semi-Discordant Loop of Craziness – 4:30

9. Sequential Relaxation Procedures – 2:10

10. Wave of Ambient Crystals – 2:26

11. Hush In A Rush – 1:40 (Exclusive Extra)

Available in RPG Maker-Ready Audio Formats

------

・This pack is for use in RPG Maker Series or the engine of your choice.

・OK to be used in Commercial projects made in RPG Maker

・You may modify some of the assets (but not redistribute them) for your own game use only.
